subject: Quarterly billing cadence & split-remit request — Skylab Health (approval needed)
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@skylabhealth.com>
To: sofia_ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Skylab Health Finance <finance@skylabhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Dec 2026 15:09:00 -0800
Subject: Request: quarterly invoicing + split remit for 2027 contract

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the productive negotiation last week. Procurement has reviewed the SOW and PO but we have one constraint from our FP&A team: Skylab runs on a quarterly invoice cadence for external SaaS spend tied to delivery milestones. They can only sign net-90 payment terms with quarterly invoicing (invoices issued at quarter boundaries, with each invoice covering completed milestones).

Concretely: they want Redwood to invoice on Jan 1 / Apr 1 / Jul 1 / Oct 1 for the quarter's completed usage, with payment due 90 days from invoice date. They also asked for split-remit handling so one invoice line goes to Skylab operations (for usage) and one line goes to the implementation partner (for migration/setup) — both need to appear on the same invoice PDF for their approval workflow.

I attached the PO and the revised SOW (SOW_Skylab_v3.pdf and Skylab_PO_2026-12.pdf).

Can Redwood accommodate a quarterly invoice cadence + Net-90? If not, what are the alternatives (shorter payment term + credit hold, or escrow)? We need to confirm before EOD Friday so procurement can process the PO.

Thanks,
Elena

--
Elena Morales
Head of Procurement, Skylab Health
elena@skylabhealth.com
+1 (415) 555-0179

From: sofia_ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@skylabhealth.com>
Cc: Skylab Health Finance <finance@skylabhealth.com>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Dec 2026 17:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: quarterly invoicing + split remit for 2027 contract

Hi Elena — appreciate the clarity and the attachments.

Short answer: we can support quarterly invoicing and split invoice lines, but Net-90 is non-standard and triggers a deal-desk + exec approval because of the extended credit exposure. To move quickly, I want to surface a recommended guardrail and ask for approval:

- Proposal: Redwood issues quarterly invoices (Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct). Payments due Net-90.
- Guardrails requested by Finance: 1) initial 25% prepayment (applied to first quarter) OR an onboarding milestone payment (one-time) to reduce upfront credit; 2) a rolling credit limit + quarterly usage cap; 3) a clause to revert to Net-30 if payment becomes >30 days overdue on any invoice.

I copied Jonas (Sales Lead) and will loop in Marissa from Revenue Ops / Billing for numeric impact. Ben, can you please review and indicate if we can approve the Net-90 + split remit under the proposed guardrails? If not, what counter proposals make this acceptable?

Elena, if Redwood approves with guardrails we’ll ask procurement to sign the PO and a short amendment to the SOW that covers the invoicing cadence and the payment triggers (we can draft).

Best,
Sofia

--
Sofia Ivanova
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai

From: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: sofia_ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 23 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: quarterly invoicing + split remit for 2027 contract

Looping finance/ops as requested. Quick notes:

- Skylab is a mid-market healthcare customer with predictable usage and strong growth signals — approving quarterly invoicing would materially help the deal close this quarter.
- Risk: Net-90 increases DSO and working capital hit; need clear credit controls.
- Suggested approval path: Ben (Sales Ops) signs off operationally; Marissa (Revenue Ops) confirms billing system can produce split-line invoices and the DocuSign amendment; exec sponsor (me) signs final approval to make the concession.

Concrete counterproposal to approve quickly:
1) Accept quarterly invoicing + Net-90 for 4 quarters as a pilot with these conditions: (a) 25% onboarding invoice due Net-7; (b) rolling credit limit equal to 3x monthly committed spend; (c) automatic conversion to Net-30 for future quarters if any invoice is >30 days overdue.
2) Add a one-time platform setup fee of $15k (can be credited back if they prepay onboarding).

Ben/Marissa — if you can confirm tech/billing supports split-line invoice and Ops can implement a 25% onboarding invoice, I will sign. Please reply with "approve as-is" or "approve with changes".

- Jonas

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, sofia_ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Dec 2026 11:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: quarterly invoicing + split remit for 2027 contract

Approve with conditions. Verified with Revenue Ops: we can generate a single invoice PDF with two invoice lines and routing metadata for Skylab's payment workflows. Billing can schedule invoices on quarter boundaries.

Conditions:
- Implementation: 25% onboarding invoice generated 7 days after DocuSign (Net-7).
- Credit: rolling credit limit = 3x expected monthly committed spend (Finance will set exact $ amount after Sofia shares expected MRR).
- Pilot term: apply Net-90 / quarterly cadence for 4 quarters; at the end of Q4 2027 we’ll review payment performance and convert to Net-30 if metrics are within tolerance.
- If any invoice is >30 days overdue, automatic reversion to Net-30 and pause of deliveries until cure.

Sofia — you can update the SOW amendment to include the billing schedule and onboarding invoice clause. Once Elena confirms acceptance we’ll route DocuSign to finalize.

Ben Carter
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
